title: Segmentation fault in torch.nn.MaxUnpool2d
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

python test1.py
```
import torch
print(torch.__version__)

tensor1 = torch.randint(
    low=-100,
    high=100,
    size=(9, 3, 7),
    dtype=torch.int16
)
tensor2 = torch.randint(
    low=0,
    high=2,
    size=(1, 6, 4, 8),
    dtype=torch.bool
)
input = [[[], 154691921484029491302139942063978250367, ()],{},[tensor1,tensor2],{}]
r1 = torch.nn.MaxUnpool2d(*input[0],**input[1])
r2 = r1(*input[2],**input[3])
```
output
```
2.9.0.dev20250828+cu129
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```
